evidence: I would play out the future of what it would like for them to be operating at their peak. I would not consequence them.
Yeah, consequence doesn't really work on people in Pride.
It's not that it doesn't work. It's, like, it's just, somebody in Pride has already looked at the, like, they understand the consequence of not doing anything.

flags.summary: A closer described extending a payment plan to six instalments on his own initiative because the agreed two-payment structure had failed, treating the number of splits as unconstrained.
evidence: And I thought I was going to lose a deposit. There's a big chance I can still get him in on Friday, because he cannot pay in two times. It doesn't say he cannot pay in six times.
And otherwise I'm going to make a plan with him that he starts next month or something, but he is still going to join someday.

flags.summary: Setter initials in call titles are added manually by setters editing calendar events after booking, which makes the attribution in this corpus self-reported and unverified.
evidence: Did Angelo walk you through how we upped Did things on the calendar to add the initials when you get a set?
Okay, so as long as you know how to do it, you edit it, you put your initials on there, you hit don't send, pretty much all you need to know.
Yeah, if you need like a reference, you can look for one of Kim's sets that are on the calendar, so you can just see how he does it.
Just makes it so the closers know it's a set, and when there's double booking, it makes it very easy on a quick glance to just know which call they're going to try and prioritize.

flags.summary: A setter booked a call into a closer's calendar using his own name and phone number, so at least one entry in this period is not a real prospect.
evidence: The first one that I did it, I put my name and my phone number, and then I just booked it myself.
I was like, wait, what the happened? No, yeah, you don't want to put your own stuff in there.

evidence: I had this call yesterday with a firefighter. Like, he was like, yeah, I'm just, I'm really not showing up well. I'm not helping the people. Like, I'm putting other people at risk. It's so easy to then close them.
As in, like, he isn't fit. So he is putting other people's lives in danger... And then it's like, then it's an easy close.
